description: Every patch into Terraria. Runtime Harmony patches only; no game file is modified.

patch.desc: Harmony patch kind ('call' = we call it).

rows.purpose: Terraria's normal start, called after our patches are in.

Fired on the first menu frame, once the engine and graphics device are up: apply all our patches then (patching JIT-compiles Terraria methods, which runs static constructors such as CaptureManager's that need the game set up) and make the Noita textures.
Our extra spawn roll after vanilla's.
Run our archetype AI for carrier NPCs and skip vanilla AI.
Skip vanilla animation for carriers (we animate from Noita sprite XML).
Draw the Noita sprite instead of the carrier's.
Show the Noita name (from Noita's translation file) on hover and in death messages.
No carrier gore; Noita blood particles instead.
Our loot for carriers, skip the carrier's vanilla drops.

rows.target: Terraria.NPC:StrikeNPC(int, float, int, bool, bool, int)
rows.purpose: Apply the enemy's Noita damage multipliers.
Move our enemy shots once per world update, right after Terraria's projectiles (not while paused or in menus).
Draw our enemy shots in the projectile layer (own SpriteBatch Begin/End with Main's transform).
Mark the hit in progress as Noita 'melee' (a swung weapon) for npc_strike; cleared by a postfix.

rows.target: Terraria.Projectile:Damage_PVE_Inner(int, NPC, Rectangle, float, int[], ref bool)
rows.purpose: Mark the hit in progress as Noita 'projectile', 'explosion' or 'melee' (melee projectiles) for npc_strike; cleared by a postfix.
